g.text: Fixed onset detectors across sampled held-out positions
One row per episode, ordered by external label then ID; identical rows in both panels.
Only three sampled positions: this is not a full trajectory or the first violating-action boundary.
J flags include ordinal ambiguous scores under the frozen threshold; unavailable is not negative.
